tickets.title: Create app/config.py with env-var-backed constants
tickets.description: Create services/knowledge-service/app/config.py per python/project-layout.md. Declare LITELLM_BASE_URL, LITELLM_MODEL, LITELLM_MAX_CHARS, and LITELLM_EMBEDDING_DIMS as UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants read from env vars or with explicit defaults. LITELLM_MASTER_KEY is already read via os.environ['LITELLM_MASTER_KEY'] in embedder.py — leave that as-is (it's a secret, not a tunable constant) but add a startup fail-fast check here. All hardcoded magic values currently scattered across modules consolidate here.
acceptance_criteria: LITELLM_BASE_URL defaults to 'http://localhost:4000/embeddings' but is overridable via env var
LITELLM_MASTER_KEY absence raises at import time with a clear message — not at first call site
All constants are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE and typed (str, int)
No other module has a hardcoded 'localhost:4000' or model string after this ticket
tickets.verification_command: cd services/knowledge-service && uv run python -c 'from app.config import LITELLM_BASE_URL; print(LITELLM_BASE_URL)'

tickets.title: Create AppError exception hierarchy in app/exceptions.py
tickets.description: Create services/knowledge-service/app/exceptions.py with a base AppError(Exception) class and typed subtypes: EmbeddingError (raised when LiteLLM proxy call fails), IndexError (raised when DB upsert fails), SearchError (raised when vector/BM25 query fails), IngestionError (raised when URL fetch or transcript fetch fails). Each subtype has a short docstring explaining why it exists. Do not catch bare Exception except at MCP tool boundary.
acceptance_criteria: AppError subclasses Exception; all subtypes subclass AppError
Each subtype has a one-line docstring
No bare except: or except Exception: in any module except the MCP tool wrappers in server.py
tickets.verification_command: cd services/knowledge-service && uv run python -c 'from app.exceptions import AppError, EmbeddingError, SearchError, IngestionError'

depends_on.reason: app/ package must exist before adding modules to it

tickets.title: Restructure flat modules into app/ package + main.py entry point
tickets.description: Move all flat .py files (vault_io.py, indexer.py, embedder.py, search.py, ingestion.py, transcript.py, server.py) into services/knowledge-service/app/. Rename: vault_io.py → app/io.py, server.py → app/tools.py (MCP tool definitions). Create main.py at service root as the sole entry point — it imports FastMCP from app/tools.py and calls mcp.run(). Update all internal imports to use 'from app.<module> import ...' form. The pyproject.toml [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] packages line must change from ['.'] to ['app'] or appropriate. The Dockerfile (if added later) will reference main.py.
acceptance_criteria: No .py files remain at services/knowledge-service/ root except main.py
main.py contains only the mcp instance import and mcp.run() call
All internal cross-module imports use 'from app.<module> import ...' form
uv run python main.py starts the server without ImportError
tickets.verification_command: cd services/knowledge-service && uv run python -c 'from app.tools import mcp; print(mcp.name)'

depends_on.reason: app/ package must exist; embedder.py will import from app.config
app/exceptions.py will be imported by restructured modules

tickets.title: Extract inline SQL to app/queries/*.sql files
tickets.description: Per python/project-layout.md: 'Any domain package that touches the DB gets its own queries/*.sql files — SQL lives in .sql files, never inlined as Python strings.' Extract all multi-line SQL strings from app/indexer.py (upsert_note), app/search.py (BM25 and vector queries), app/tools.py (list_notes SELECT), and app/embedder.py (SELECT content_hash, INSERT/UPDATE vault_embeddings) into named .sql files under app/queries/. Load them at module level via Path(__file__).parent / 'queries' / 'filename.sql' read_text().
acceptance_criteria: No multi-line SQL string literals remain in any .py file
All .sql files are under app/queries/
SQL files are loaded via pathlib at module level, not via open() inline
uv run python -c 'from app.indexer import upsert_note' runs without error
tickets.verification_command: cd services/knowledge-service && python -c 'from pathlib import Path; missing = [f for f in ["upsert_note","upsert_embedding","get_embedding_hash","list_notes","bm25_search","vector_search"] if not (Path("app/queries")/f"{f}.sql").exists()]; assert not missing, missing'

depends_on.reason: modules must be in app/ before their SQL is extracted to app/queries/

tickets.title: Wrap external call boundaries with AppError; fix untyped params: list
tickets.description: Per python/error-handling.md: never let an uncaught external exception propagate silently. (1) Wrap app/embedder._embed() httpx.post() in try/except httpx.HTTPStatusError and httpx.RequestError — raise EmbeddingError with message. (2) Wrap app/tools.list_notes() DB query in try/except and return {"error": ...} dict on failure (consistent with get_note pattern already in place). (3) Fix app/tools.py list_notes params: list → params: list[Any] (import Any from typing). (4) embedder.upsert_embedding — the outer function already has a try via the context manager; ensure EmbeddingError from _embed() propagates up correctly and is caught at the MCP tool level in app/tools.py add_note/update_note.
acceptance_criteria: app/embedder._embed() raises EmbeddingError on any httpx failure — no bare exception propagates
app/tools.list_notes() returns {'error': str} dict on DB failure — does not raise
params type annotation is params: list[Any]
add_note and update_note MCP tools catch EmbeddingError and return {'error': str} dict
tickets.verification_command: cd services/knowledge-service && uv run python -c 'from app.embedder import _embed' && uv run mypy app/embedder.py app/tools.py --ignore-missing-imports

depends_on.reason: modules must be in app/ first

tickets.title: Bootstrap tests/ with conftest.py and initial test suite
tickets.description: Per python/testing.md: tests/ mirrors app/ structure. Create: (1) tests/conftest.py — inserts service root onto sys.path and provides a pytest fixture mocking the httpx client for embedder tests. (2) tests/test_embedder.py — covers: _embed() success (mock httpx → returns float list), _embed() raises EmbeddingError on 4xx, upsert_embedding() returns False when content_hash unchanged. (3) tests/test_tools.py — covers: list_notes returns count+notes keys, get_note returns error dict on FileNotFoundError. Mark any test requiring a real DB connection with @pytest.mark.slow.
acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -m 'not slow' exits 0
test_embedder.py covers success, 4xx error, hash-unchanged skip
test_tools.py covers list_notes structure and get_note file-not-found
No test uses unittest.mock.patch on internal domain classes
tickets.verification_command: cd services/knowledge-service && uv run pytest tests/ -m 'not slow' -v

depends_on.reason: EmbeddingError must exist for error-path tests; embedder must be in app/ for import
